text:
ashley: Nightly perf alert — dashboard shows ~18% throughput drop for medium-length workloads (seq 256-768) and p99 tail up ~230ms. Noticed after last night's deploy.
matt: Saw the same. CI's nightly-batching-e2e failed this morning.
deepa: @matt can you paste the CI failure snippet?
matt: CI summary: mean tokens/sec: 412 -> 337 (-18.1%), p99 latency: 720ms -> 950ms. Log snippet: ```2026-03-18T03:12:14Z pipeline: flush triggered; batch_size=8; expected~32``` 
samir: I bisected locally — points to merge PR #4512 "batching: introduce stride scheduler" (commit abcdef1) rolled at ~02:05 UTC.
ashley: Confirmed on prod-canary: smaller observed batch sizes and more frequent flushes. CPU wakeups increased.
eli: Profiling (pprof) flamegraph shows repeated scheduler flush hotspots every ~1.1s causing KV cache churn. Link: https://perf.internal/flame/189345 (internal)
matt: git bisect ended on abcdef1 — change reduced stride window from 64->16 in scheduler. That would explain batch shrinkage.
deepa: KV hit-rate dipped ~6% in the same window (0.82 -> 0.76), so more KV misses + backend calls.
samir: Reproduced on local perf harness. Command I used: ```bazel run //perf:nightly -- --model=stable-13b --seq=512 --qps=30``` Results: tokens/sec 330 vs baseline 405.
ashley: CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/12345 (perf logs + traces). @ci-bot any historic flakiness?
ci-bot: Test history for nightly-batching-e2e: 3 consecutive fails since 1893456000. Suspected culprit: commit abcdef1.
matt: Proposal: revert PR #4520 (revert of #4512) to restore previous stride window, while we iterate on a fixed stride-aware heuristic.
deepa: Quick mitigation idea: conditional stride scaling — if median seq_len > 256, multiply stride window by 2. Should be low-risk.
samir: I'll open a revert + feature-flag patch. If revert lands, we should freeze canary rollout and monitor.
eli: Rollout plan: hold at 10% until tokens/sec and KV hit converge to baseline. Watch p99 and sys CPU jitter.
oliver: Oncall update: paused rollout on hostpool-gpu-2 and rolled back that pool to previous image.
ashley: Also adding median seq_len metric to nightly regression alert set so this type of change triggers an earlier signal.
matt: Postmortem note: batching heuristic change shipped without targeted mid-seq e2e perf runs. Add to pre-merge checklist.
deepa: PRs opened: #4523 (revert abcdef1) and #4524 (stride-scaling with feature flag). CI perf runs started.
ci-bot: Perf CI run 1/3 for #4523: PASS (baseline tokens/sec 403, current 401 +/- noise).
samir: I'll kick off extended harness overnight and collect pprof + batch-size histograms.
eli: Follow-ups assigned — deepa: add tests/alerts; samir: extended runs + traces; matt: write postmortem draft; ashley: monitor dashboards and update incident channel.
ashley: :thumbsup: Moving this thread into incident log. If anyone finds related anomalies in other pools please ping here.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-118, severity P2, status: investigating."
